title: ogr-node-core
description: Platform-independent OGR node engine: the sketch on top, hardware only through three HAL interfaces

blocks.title: Your sketch
blocks.details:
How a module firmware uses the library (README, Usage):

1. Create `OgrNode node(ClassId, isAnchor)`.
2. In `setup()`, call `addEndpoint(type, mode, format, onRead, onWrite, ctx)` once per endpoint; call order fixes the `EP_SELECT` index.
3. Call `node.begin(transport, gpio, storage)` with objects from an `ogr-node-hal-*` package (or `begin(transport, gpio)` without PLANT_UID support).
4. Call `node.update()` (or `update(millis())`) every `loop()`.

Optional hooks: `onRestart`, `onPlantUidChanged`, `onEnumerated`. They may run in ISR context: keep them fast.

children.title: Enumeration lifecycle
children.details:
Source: `src/OgrNode.cpp` `updateImpl()`, `applySetAddr()`, `doRestart()`

- States: `WaitingForEnIn` → `Unassigned` (listening on `0x08`) → `Assigned`.
- `SET_ADDR` assigns the address and raises `EN_OUT`; `RESTART` drops back to `WaitingForEnIn`.
- If EN_IN drops before `SET_ADDR`, the node leaves the bus again; after `SET_ADDR` it keeps its address.
- `setEnInHoldMs()` (with `update(nowMs)`) ignores EN_IN for a while after boot.
- Transport `setAddress()`/`end()` are **deferred to `update()`**: calling them from the ISR path wedged the AVR USI peripheral.

children.title: Register access
children.details:
Source: `src/OgrNode.cpp` `onI2cWrite()`, `onI2cRead()`, `writePec()`, `readPec()`

- Implements `IOgrProtocolSink`: the transport hands over a whole buffered frame.
- Writes: verify the PEC; on mismatch discard and set `STATUS = Error` (always ACKed, spec §5.3).
- Reads: fill the system block, descriptor window (`0x20`, 3 bytes) or data window (`0x40`, 4 bytes, little-endian), then append the PEC.
- An `EP_SELECT` index ≥ `EP_COUNT` is ignored and sets `STATUS = Error`.

children.title: Endpoints
children.details:
Source: `src/OgrNode.h` `EndpointDef`, `addEndpoint()`

- Up to `OGR_MAX_ENDPOINTS` (default 8, build flag), no dynamic allocation.
- Values are never cached: `onRead`/`onWrite` are called live from the data-window transaction.
- `ctx` lets one callback serve several endpoints.

children.title: PLANT_UID
children.details:
Source: `src/OgrNode.cpp` `setPlantUidByte()`, flush in `updateImpl()`

- Always kept in RAM, so reads never touch storage.
- Byte writes stage in RAM; the flush to `IOgrStorage` happens in `update()`, never on the transport path.
- With `update(nowMs)` the flush waits until writes have been quiet for `kPlantUidSettleMs` (500 ms): flushing after each of the four byte writes stalled the CPU on CH32V003 and persisted a truncated UID.
- Without storage (`begin(transport, gpio)`), reads return `0xFFFFFFFF` and writes are ignored.

children.title: IOgrTransport
children.details:
Source: `src/OgrTransport.h`

- `begin(sink, address)`, `setAddress(address)`, `end()`, `poll()`.
- Delivers each completed write frame to `IOgrProtocolSink::onI2cWrite()` and asks `onI2cRead(reg, …)` to fill the read response.
- Needs only buffered frames, no per-byte ACK/NACK control.
- `poll()` is for transports that do deferred work outside the ISR (e.g. AVR USI).

children.title: IOgrGpio
children.details:
Source: `src/OgrGpio.h`

- `begin()`, `readEnIn()`, `writeEnOut(high)`.
- Plain polled digital I/O; no interrupts needed.

children.title: IOgrStorage
children.details:
Source: `src/OgrStorage.h`

- `loadPlantUid(uid)`, `savePlantUid(uid)`. Mandatory for anchor modules.
- `NullStorage`: stub for non-anchor modules without UID support.

children.title: Implementations
children.details:
This repo has no hardware code. Implementations of the three interfaces live in separate packages:

- `ogr-node-hal-avr` — ATmega328 (TWI), ATtiny85 (USI)
- `ogr-node-hal-esp32-arduino` — ESP32 family on Arduino `Wire`
- `ogr-node-hal-esp32` — ESP-IDF
- `ogr-node-hal-ch32v003` — CH32V003

For host tests, `test/mocks/MockHal.h` implements all three.

blocks.title: Constants
blocks.details:
Sources: `src/OgrTypes.h`, `src/OgrCrc8.h`

- `OgrTypes.h` mirrors spec docs 04, 06 and 07: register addresses (`Reg`), `Status`, `RestartType`, `SYS_FLAGS` bits, `ClassId`, `TypeId`, `Mode`, `Format`, default address `0x08`, protocol version `0x10`, frame size limits.
- `OgrCrc8.h`: CRC-8/SMBUS (poly `0x07`, init `0x00`) used for the PEC byte.

When the spec changes, these two files change first.

blocks.title: Host tests
blocks.details:
Sources: `test/test_protocol/test_protocol.cpp`, `test/test_crc8/test_crc8.cpp`, `test/mocks/MockHal.h`, `platformio.ini`

- Run on the host with PlatformIO `native` + Unity: `pio test -e native`. No board or toolchain needed.
- `MockHal.h` fakes transport, GPIO and storage.
- Covered: EN_IN wait and drop, `SET_ADDR`, bad PEC, `EP_SELECT` paging, little-endian data, write callbacks, PLANT_UID deferred and settled flush, EN_IN hold, no-storage mode, `RESTART`, deferred transport reconfiguration.
- `test_crc8` checks the CRC against known vectors.
